Prepare the steps of a report run

Source: R/run_report.R
prepare_report_steps.Rd

Resolves, stages and validates the inputs of a run in its versioned output directory, and locates the templates of the requested steps. Everything run_report() does before the first step is written.

Usage

prepare_report_steps(
  args,
  extra_render_params,
  output_dir,
  on_resolve_inputs = NULL,
  on_before_render = NULL
)

Arguments

args

Named list of the input arguments of run_report().

extra_render_params

Named list of deployment-specific render parameters.

output_dir

Character string of the versioned output directory.

on_resolve_inputs, on_before_render

Function or NULL, as in run_report().

Value

A list with the validated arguments (args), the resolved extra_render_params, data_type, steps, mae, mae_path, is_prism_data, and the step files in render order (rmd_files) with their template_paths and output_paths.
